#summary Run instructions.

==Checkout==

  * Go to Source page http://code.google.com/p/minimmorts/source/checkout and follow instructions to get your copy of server and client.

==Download third-party stuff==

  * Go to Downloads page http://code.google.com/p/minimmorts/downloads/list and download latest version of *Server lib* and *Client sprites*. Follow instructions at the downloads description to unpack archives to right place.

==Run server==

  * You can compile server manually but its not recommended even for advanced users. Its better to use NetBeans IDE and just open ready project in the server/ directory. Note what project folder name contains version of NetBeans IDE where project was created. Newer projects often cannot be opened in older NetBeans IDE.

  * Copy file config.xml from server/ directory to file config-home.xml in the directory of project what you open _(for example in NetBeans-7.1.2 project/ directory)_

  * After you open project just set project as main project and run it.

==Run client==

  * When server started it listen port on your localhost. Go to client folder client/HTML5/src/ and open file client.html in your browser.

Enjoy :)
